label: 📈 Interpolate nulls
description: Linear or spline interpolation between known values. Numeric columns only. Most useful for time series where missing readings should follow the trend established by surrounding observations.

method.label: Method
method.help: linear: connect known endpoints with a straight line. nearest: copy the nearer neighbour.

sortColumn.label: Sort column
sortColumn.help: Sort by this column before interpolating (e.g. timestamp).
